{{Top|leg}}
A '''micro-charge''' was a small [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charge]] that could be used to simulate impact from weapons fire. They were commonly used by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] dramatists who specialized in faking [[Assassin/Legends|assassinations]].
